messages:
Samir: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem (INC-2026). Main takeaways: recurring cache-thrash pattern + delayed escalation. We need 3 deliverables: triage checklist edits (faster failover commands), a clear escalation path (who to page and when), and an action tracker with owners + firm deadlines. I'll seed owners below — please confirm or reassign.

Claire: Taking the triage checklist + failover commands. I'll create a draft and attach the exact command snippets. Creating JIRA INF-3123 for this. Target: EOD Thu.

Marta: I'll own the escalation path & paging policy (who to page for sev2 vs sev1, APAC backup contacts). Will include an on-call overlap table. Can we list backup contacts for APAC?

Lukas: I'll spin up the action tracker (spreadsheet + timeline) and link it to the postmortem. Also proposing weekly automated playbook smoke tests — should we add that as a discrete action (INF-3125)?

Samir: Yes add automated smoke tests. Lukas + Claire to prototype. Also add these quick eviction commands into the triage checklist so SREs can run them during an incident. Put this in the playbook under "Immediate mitigation".

Claire: Draft mitigation command block (will paste into playbook):
```
# Evict prefix cache for inference pool
infractl cache evict --pool model-inference --prefix "kv_cache:v1"
# fallback request routing to L2 pool
infractl route set --service inference --fallback l2-small
# one-off eviction via ops API
curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood/api/v1/evict -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"pool":"model-inference","prefix":"kv_cache:v1"}'
```

Lukas: Can you also add a check list item to validate KV cache size and recent eviction logs? For the smoke test, we should assert 95th latency < 500ms for small load and verify no error spikes. If 95th > 750ms for 5m, run the failover steps and page P0.

Marta: I'll enumerate escalation targets: on-call SRE -> oncall team lead -> eng-runtime pager -> product oncall. For APAC backup contact add Mei (regional SRE). I'll include contact table and rotation window notes.

IncidentBot: Postmortem INC-2026 summary: actions created -> INF-3123 (triage checklist + cmds), INF-3124 (escalation path + contacts), INF-3125 (playbook smoke tests). Owners: Claire (INF-3123), Marta (INF-3124), Lukas (INF-3125). Due dates: INF-3123 2026-04-09, INF-3124 2026-04-10, INF-3125 2026-04-17. Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3123 etc.

Claire: I've added the mitigation commands and a short "decision tree" section to the draft. Also added exact alert thresholds and the run command to trigger fallback. Scheduling a quick walkthrough Fri 11:00am PT to run through the edits — can folks join?

Samir: I'll join and bring the incident timeline + metric diffs to show recurrence patterns. Lukas — can you add the action tracker link to the calendar invite?

Lukas: Done — invite sent and spreadsheet attached. I've added columns: owner, jira, status, due, recurrence-monitor, notes. Set recurrence-monitor -> Lukas, metric -> cache-hit-rate & tail-latency.

Marta: Assigning INF-3124 to myself. I'll include APAC backups and update escalation matrix to reflect new oncall rotation starting April.

Claire: Marked INF-3123 'in progress' and linked the draft playbook changes here: https://gist.github.com/redwood/triage-draft. Will push PR to the runbook repo after walkthrough. :thumbsup:

Samir: Thanks all. Expect small runbook/playbook changes by Fri EOD. We'll re-evaluate recurrence after two weeks of automated smoke runs and watch the recurrence-monitor metric. If pattern persists, we'll schedule a follow-up retrospective to dig deeper.

Lukas: Noted — I'll set a 2-week checkpoint and add a follow-up task in the tracker.

Claire: I'll also add a short test script (one-liner) so oncall can validate mitigation quickly: `bash tests/evict_and_smoke.sh --pool model-inference`

Marta: Good. I'll document exact paging time windows and escalation contacts in the playbook doc.

Samir: Great work. Closing thread for updates — please update the JIRA tickets as you progress so IncidentBot can post status updates.
